title: Node Red→Amber easing branch of node_strain_transition has no test (pipe twin is pinned, node side is not)
detail: The Red→Amber easing (cleared sign names the ENDED level, no re-raise) is pinned only via the separate pipe_strain_transition (test @3 CLEARED Pipe_Critical 'still amber'). node_strain_transition's easing branch is distinct code, and warn.dem's host drains Red→None in one step — no node easing anywhere.
recommended_fix: Add a node test: a red node eased to amber (e.g. stuck backlog 3→2 packets) must emit exactly one CLEARED Node_Critical, no RAISED Node_Strained.

title: Pressure replication to member pipes of a multi-pipe bundle is never exercised — no test or demo draws two parallel pipes in one bundle
evidence:
core/determinism_test.odin:91-93:
// Seed the static 1.2 fixture: residential(0) ← router(1) → content_host(2),
// all on row y=15, 12 tiles apart (standard span 12 ≤ max 14 — legal draws).
demos/sla.dem:17-20 (and identically qos_contention/qos_emphasis/qos/warn):
	at 100ms draw 0 1 standard
	at 100ms draw 1 2 standard
	at 100ms draw 3 1 standard
	at 100ms draw 4 1 standard
core/warnings.odin:218-223 (the replication loop — every live pipe carries its bundle's pressure):
	bs := state.bundles.pipe_bundle[ps]
	new := Strain_Level.None
	if bs != NO_BUNDLE && lane_bound_units > 0 {
		new = strain_level(press[bs] * 100 / lane_bound_units, w.pipe_amber_pct, w.pipe_red_pct)
	}
	cr.pipe_strain[ps] = pipe_strain_transition(state, tick, cr.pipe_strain[ps], new, t.pipe_id[ps])
detail: The E9 pressure contract's 'replicates to every member pipe' leg (bundles.odin: 'live member count (the render-width proxy)') has zero coverage: every fixture/demo bundle has exactly one member pipe, so a two-pipe bundle's shared pressure + member-pipe overlay is untested at unit and golden level.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test drawing two parallel pipes in one bundle (e.g. two res→router lanes): both member pipes must carry the bundle's level and emit their own events.

title: Router (1 waiting = 75% amber, 2 = 150% red) and residential (any waiting = 600% red) strain-math pins are not directly tested
detail: Only the content_host throughput is exercised (75%/112% crossings); the router 75%/150% and residential 600% values named in the pinned-contract design notes are arithmetic on the same generic formula (nload*100/throughput vs 70/90), verified by no test or golden.
recommended_fix: Pin one router-based and one residential-based strain case in warnings_test (router 1-2 waiting; residential 1 waiting = red) to lock the node-type-specific values.

title: Forecast purity ('never fires') has no unit-level assertion — the forecast-window test clears events without checking they are empty
evidence:
core/warnings_test.odin:200-212:
		check(t, &s, cat, 2999, 1, 0, true)
		check(t, &s, cat, 3000, 0, 0, false) // window closed (start + duration)
...
		}
		clear(&s.events)
	}
detail: test_forecast_window_rows steps era-3 forecast ticks then unconditionally clear(&s.events) — a forecast that emitted events would still pass. Purity is pinned only indirectly by warn.dem's golden event stream/T1 (chunk 4), not by a unit assertion.
recommended_fix: In test_forecast_window_rows, assert len(s.events) == 0 before clearing — a forecast-bearing tick must emit zero events.

title: Era-3 sandbox session config (goal 0 / cap 0, win-lose disabled) has no automated pin
evidence:
app/main.odin:157-158:
	app.state.era = APP_ERA            // 4.1: the streaming-surge era (run setup — the director + forecast schedule)
	app.state.goal = app.win_goal       // the win/lose session config (run setup)
app/main.odin:32-33:
WIN_GOAL :: u32(0)            // 0 = win/lose disabled (4.1 session)
LOSE_TICK_CAP :: u64(0)       // 0 = no cap (4.1 session)
detail: The acceptance's 'start_run sets era 3 + goal 0/cap 0 (win/lose disabled)' is app-level config verified only by the warn.dem golden run; no test asserts the session's goal/cap are zero, so a regression would pass CI silently.
recommended_fix: Add a small core/app test asserting start_run's session (era 3, goal 0, tick_cap 0) and that win_lose_eval cannot terminate such a run.

title: Dead-node-slot never-warns path (demolished node) is untested — including the deliberate silent Red→None with no CLEARED event
detail: A node demolished while Red drops to None via the force-assign + continue (no node_strain_transition call → no phantom CLEARED event — deliberate per the comment). No unit test demolishes a strained node, and demolish.dem is zero-traffic, so the branch is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a test: strain a node red, demolish it, and assert node_strain goes None with zero warning events emitted.

title: Strain thresholds at the exact 69/70/89/90/91 boundary values are not pinned
detail: Crossings are pinned only at 75/112/100/83/67/50 — all ≥8 points from the thresholds — so the documented inclusive-lower-bound semantics (>=70, >=90) could be off-by-one at exactly 69/70/89/90/91 without any test or golden failing.
recommended_fix: Pin boundary cases: e.g. host backlog yielding exactly 70% (amber) and 90% (red), and 69%/89% (None/amber) — or unit-test strain_level directly at 69/70/89/90/91.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 = 100% (all 13 P0 paths pinned: no-flicker transit, pressure-vs-E9 bound, forecast boundaries, replay byte-identity, LOG_VERSION 3, zero-traffic neutrality, fail-fast rows, warn.dem; both negative proofs verified — sla/10000ms.png zero changed pixels, 14/14 harness demos PASS, 97/97 core tests green). P1 = 2 gaps of ~11 (node Red→Amber easing branch, multi-pipe bundle pressure replication) ≈ 82%.
recommended_fix: Add the two P1 tests (node Red→Amber easing; two-pipe bundle replication) plus the four P3 pins; gate then reaches PASS.
